name: autoclearcut
title: Automatic Clear Cutting
author: blacke4dawn
description: Automatically marks trees, rocks, cliffs, ruins and other obstacles for deconstruction within a roboport's construction area when it's built or upgraded. Can also continuously clear around the player within their personal roboport's range, toggled from the shortcut bar or with a keybind. Each category of object can be turned on or off in the map settings, and objects from many planet mods are supported.
